title.narrative: YEM035N Yemen Joint Response 2022-23

description.promeva:title: Description (English)
description.narrative: This is a 2-year Yemen Joint Response, consisting of 7 YJR members and 9 local partners. The Joint Response for 2022-2023 has been designed according to identified priority governorates, based on those where humanitarian needs and gaps are known to be high and where members have access and presence to implement, either directly or with local partners, or a combination. As in previous years of the Yemen JR, the overall objective of this programme is to provide multi-sectoral and integrated life-saving humanitarian support to people in need, prioritising the most vulnerable population, and facilitate early recovery and resilience of conflict population in Yemen, while ensuring that all activities promote equitable access to assistance for women, girls, boys, and men.

title.narrative: Water, Sanitation & Hygiene - output
Number of people having access to dignified, safe, clean and functional excreta disposal facilities

comment.narrative: CARE constructed the first 40 latrines in 2022 disaggregated as 40 HHs, 262 individuals in Qatabah-Alaradi area. The other 40 latrines will be constructed in 2023. More details will be provided at the end report.

Care Conducted a primary assessment in Al-Aradhi area in Qatbah district, high percentage of marginalized groups who do not have latrines was found and utilizing open defecation practices. The CARE team conducted a technical assessment to construct 40 permanent latrines in the area to minimize the risks of disease spreading. BoQs and technical drawings were designed and submitted to the support unit and the procurement process already started in September.
HHs latrine - selection of the villages are being done. Expected to complete selection at end of months, Procurement will start. Overall Construction work is expected to complete in November.
In December 2023, the local partner ( Diversity ) accomplished the successful construction of 40 latrines in the Qa'atabah District of Al Dhale Governorate.
